name: deps-audit
title: 의존성·런타임 보안 점검
use: Monthly and before a release: runtime/dependency security-patch check; run security-checks alongside.
rules:
Repo: this repository (the folder holding AGENTS.md). AGENTS.md rules override this prompt.
No runtime switch (python interpreter in the launchd plist, Node major, Chrome channel) without owner approval: propose it in summary only.
No new third-party dependency: the code stays stdlib-only Python and node: builtins only.
The code must keep running on /usr/bin/python3 3.9 syntax.
NEVER restart the live viewer, NEVER commit/stash/checkout/reset/add. Never read credentials.
Scope: only what this checkout depends on (the viewer's python and its imports; release adds the dev tooling). One check run = one Markdown report (scanners + deps) beside security-log.jsonl; never copy tool messages or secret values from it. The threat-model review stays in the security-checks pipeline, run alongside this one each month; it is a separate run, not a stage here.

stages.title: 점검
stages.task: Run `/usr/bin/python3 scripts/arch_checks.py --repo <this repo> --category security` once from this repository: it runs the security scanners and the dependency/runtime audit (scripts/deps_audit.py) and writes one Markdown report. Its printed summary line ends with `· report <name>` (plus `· deps N FAIL/M WARN`); the report is ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/<key>/<name> (find it with `ls ${MAILBOX_DIR:-~/.mailbox-mcp}/arch/*/<name>`). Read it and report as findings every FAIL/WARN line of «Dependencies and runtimes» (item and detail only) and every scanner finding (rule id, file:line, severity); name tools that were skipped, missing or failed. List OK lines in summary. Change nothing; do not rerun.

stages.title: 트리아지
stages.task: For each finding decide: action now, owner decision, or no action. Give the risk and what must not change. A runtime switch is always an owner decision (summary, not a slice). Slices only for approved, minimal work: EOL table/date refresh in scripts/deps_audit.py, code fixes for deprecations, removing a foreign import. Change nothing.

stages.title: 업데이트
stages.task: Do your slice only, minimal: refresh version tables and the checked date, or fix the deprecation. Keep 3.9 syntax and stdlib only. Report changed files; anything else goes in findings.

stages.title: 검증
stages.task: Run the gate once and report each failing step as a finding with file/line. Do not fix anything.
